# opnsense_trafficshaper_queue (Resource)

Traffic shaper queues (Firewall > Shaper > Queues): weighted shares of a pipe. Deleting one removes it from the configuration and the ruleset, but OPNsense leaves the now-unused queue in dummynet until the shaper is reset (Firewall > Shaper > Status > Reset) or the firewall reboots; the provider does not reset it because that briefly flushes every ipfw rule, including captive portal ones.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_trafficshaper_pipe" "wan_up" {
  bandwidth   = 20
  description = "WAN upload"
}

# Give VoIP a larger share of the upload pipe than bulk traffic.
resource "opnsense_trafficshaper_queue" "voip" {
  pipe        = opnsense_trafficshaper_pipe.wan_up.id
  weight      = 80
  description = "VoIP"
}

resource "opnsense_trafficshaper_queue" "bulk" {
  pipe        = opnsense_trafficshaper_pipe.wan_up.id
  weight      = 20
  description = "Bulk"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `pipe` (String) UUID of the `opnsense_trafficshaper_pipe` this queue shares.

### Optional

- `buckets` (Number) Hash table size for dynamic queues; unset uses the system default.
- `codel_ecn_enable` (Boolean) Mark packets with ECN instead of dropping them. Defaults to `false`.
- `codel_enable` (Boolean) Enable CoDel active queue management. Defaults to `false`.
- `codel_interval` (Number) CoDel interval in ms; unset uses 100.
- `codel_target` (Number) CoDel target delay in ms; unset uses 5.
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to `""`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable the queue. Defaults to `true`.
- `mask` (String) Dynamic per-host queues: `none`, `src-ip`, `dst-ip`, `src-ip6` or `dst-ip6`. Defaults to `"none"`.
- `pie_enable` (Boolean) Enable PIE active queue management. Defaults to `false`.
- `weight` (Number) Share of the pipe relative to its other queues (1-100). Defaults to `100`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the queue.
- `number` (String) Queue number assigned by OPNsense (from 10000).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UUID
terraform import opnsense_trafficshaper_queue.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
